title: Small cave river flow
author: Duasun
changes: Real recording of a small stream of water gurgling and bubbling inside a cave, used for the olm (a blind salamander that lives in underground cave waters and makes no well-known call). Trimmed to 0.25–2.95 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 2.0 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording. No high-pass is applied because the clip has no measurable low-frequency rumble.
